sections.section: RULE - Balochistan Population Welfare Department (Non-Technical) (Basic Pay Scale 16 and Above) Service Rules 1993
sections.description:
BALOCHISTAN POPULATION WELFARE DEPARTMENT (NON-TECHNICAL) (BASIC PAY
SCALE 16 AND ABOVE) SERVICE RULES, 1993
BALOCHISTAN POPULATION WELFARE DEPARTMENT (NON-TECHNICAL) (BASIC PAY
SCALE 16 AND ABOVE) SERVICE RULES, 1993
(Amendments in the Appendix)
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 1st August, 2012]
No.S.O
(R-II)(19)4/2012-S&GAD/1349-98, dated 1-8-2012.---In exercise of the powers
conferred by Section 25 of the Balochistan Civil Servants Act, 1974 (Act No.IX
of 1974), the Government of Balochistan is pleased to make the following
amendments in the Balochistan Population Welfare Department (Non-Technical)
(Basic Pay Scale 16 and Above) Service Rules, 1993, namely:--
In the aforesaid rules, in appendix,--
(1) against
serial Nos.3 and 4 respectively, in column 4, for the existing entries the
following shall be substituted:--
"(a) 20%
by initial recruitment; and
(b) 80% by
promotion from amongst the members of the Service holding the post of Assistant
Director (B-17)/District Population Welfare Officer (Low Density) (B-17)/Tehsil
Population Welfare Officer (B-17)/ Deputy District Population Welfare Officer
(B-17)/Accounts Officer
(B-17) having at least five years service as such,
on seniority cum fitness basis.";
"(2) at
serial No.5, for the existing entries the following shall be substituted:--
5.
District Population
Welfare Officer (Low Density) (B-17)/ Tehsil Population Welfare Officer
(B-17)/ Deputy District Population Welfare Officer (B-17)/ Assistant Director
(B-17).
Master Degree (2nd
Division from a recognized University. Provided that the degree in Sociology, Psychology, Social Work,
Demo-graphy, Statistics, Mathematics, Public Administration/ Business
Adminis-tration/ Commerce, Economics or Social Science shall be preferred.
(a) 75% by initial
recruitment; and (b) 25% by promotion from amongst the members of the Service
holding the post of Research
Supervisor/ Statistical
Investigator/ Monitoring and Evolution Officer/ Assistant District Population
Welfare Officer/ Accountant/ Superintendent (B-16), having at least three
years Service as such, on seniority cum fitness basis."; and
(3) The
entries at S.Nos.6 and 7 shall be omitted.
